headline_seed: Lindsay Clancy to face retrial for deaths of her three children in March 2027 - BBC
draft_text:
A judge set Lindsay Clancy's retrial for March 29, 2027, after her first jury deadlocked 11-to-1 — the majority leaning not guilty by reason of insanity. The New York Times and BBC News confirm prosecutors have not stated their charges.

And that's the mews.
